name: introduce-typed-media-location
title: Introduce a typed media location for decoder sources
description: 1.0 gate 4 of 9. Audit P2-5 and P2-7: local-vs-HTTP selection uses AsRef<Path>, lossy string conversion, and repeated case-sensitive prefix checks. A typed MediaLocation is the natural boundary and also centralizes URL redaction and loudness-cache source identity/freshness.
creator: Asaiuta
